content: PaddleNLP lightweight Chinese NER: ernie-tiny ~25-30MB, ernie-3.0-nano ~50-80MB, ernie-3.0-micro ~70-100MB. Functional but pulls paddlepaddle binary (CPU ~700MB install footprint + conflicts with RapidOCR's onnxruntime). Local-first constraint and rapidocr-onnxruntime already running suggest not adding PaddleNLP for v39. Defer to v2+ as architecture-layer swap slot per ARCH-03.
